Use haversine: a = sin^2(dlat/2)+cos(lat1)*cos(lat2)*sin^2(dlon/2). dlat=12.03°=0.210 rad. dlon=110.08°=1.922 rad. sin^2(dlat/2)=sin(0.105)^2≈(0.1047)^2=0.01096. cos(lat1)=cos(0.869)=0.647; cos(lat2)=cos(0.659)=0.790. sin^2(dlon/2)=sin(0.961)^2≈(0.819)^2=0.671. We can approximate manually: difference in lat ~12.03°, diff in lon ~249.92°. But due to crossing 180°, we need to adjust. Actually lon difference: 127.5 - (-122.42) = 249.92°, but wrap around: 360-249.92=110.08°, so difference ~110.08°. Use haversine: a = sin^2(dlat/2)+cos(lat1)*cos(lat2)*sin^2(dlon/2). dlat=12.03°=0.210 rad. dlon=110.08°=1.922 rad. sin^2(dlat/2)=sin(0.105)^2≈(0.1047)^2=0.01096. cos(lat1)=cos(0.869)=0.647; cos(lat2)=cos(0.659)=0.790. sin^2(dlon/2)=sin(0.961)^2≈(0.819)^2=0.671. So a=0.01096+0.647*0.790*0.671=0.01096+0.647*0.530=0.01096+0.343=0.354. c=2*atan2(sqrt(a), sqrt(1-a))=2*atan2(0.595,0.803)=2*0.667=1.334 rad. Distance=R*c, R=6371 km => 6371*1.334=8495 km. Actually lon difference: 127.5 - (-122.42) = 249.92°, but wrap around: 360-249.92=110.08°, so difference ~110.08°. Use haversine: a = sin^2(dlat/2)+cos(lat1)*cos(lat2)*sin^2(dlon/2). dlat=12.03°=0.210 rad. dlon=110.08°=1.922 rad. sin^2(dlat/2)=sin(0.105)^2≈(0.1047)^2=0.01096. cos(lat1)=cos(0.869)=0.647; cos(lat2)=cos(0.659)=0.790. sin^2(dlon/2)=sin(0.961)^2≈(0.819)^2=0.671. We can approximate manually: difference in lat ~12.03°, diff in lon ~249.92°. But due to crossing 180°, we need to adjust. Actually lon difference: 127.5 - (-122.42) = 249.92°, but wrap around: 360-249.92=110.08°, so difference ~110.08°. Use haversine: a = sin^2(dlat/2)+cos(lat1)*cos(lat2)*sin^2(dlon/2). dlat=12.03°=0.210 rad. dlon=110.08°=1.922 rad. sin^2(dlat/2)=sin(0.105)^2≈(0.1047)^2=0.01096. cos(lat1)=cos(0.869)=0.647; cos(lat2)=cos(0.659)=0.790. sin^2(dlon/2)=sin(0.961)^2≈(0.819)^2=0.671. So a=0.01096+0.647*0.790*0.671=0.01096+0.647*0.530=0.01096+0.343=0.354. c=2*atan2(sqrt(a), sqrt(1-a))=2*atan2(0.595,0.803)=2*0.667=1.334 rad. Distance=R*c, R=6371 km => 6371*1.334=8495 km. Actually lon difference: 127.5 - (-122.42) = 249.92°, but wrap around: 360-249.92=110.08°, so difference ~110.08°. Use haversine: a = sin^2(dlat/2)+cos(lat1)*cos(lat2)*sin^2(dlon/2). dlat=12.03°=0.210 rad. dlon=110.08°=1.922 rad. sin^2(dlat/2)=sin(0.105)^2≈(0.1047)^2=0.01096. cos(lat1)=cos(0.869)=0.647; cos(lat2)=cos(0.659)=0.790. sin^2(dlon/2)=sin(0.961)^2≈(0.819)^2=0.671. So a=0.01096+0.647*0.790*0.671=0.01096+0.647*0.530=0.01096+0.343=0.354. c=2*atan2(sqrt(a), sqrt(1-a))=2*atan2(0.595,0.803)=2*0.667=1.334 rad. Distance=R*c, R=6371 km => 6371*1.334=8495 km. Use haversine: a = sin^2(dlat/2)+cos(lat1)*cos(lat2)*sin^2(dlon/2). dlat=12.03°=0.210 rad. dlon=110.08°=1.922 rad. sin^2(dlat/2)=sin(0.105)^2≈(0.1047)^2=0.01096. cos(lat1)=cos(0.869)=0.647; cos(lat2)=cos(0.659)=0.790. sin^2(dlon/2)=sin(0.961)^2≈(0.819)^2=0.671.
